text_block_list.text: One day, while heading to my office...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: O-ouuuch!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I hear a cry of pain coming from the
infirmary. It's Эль Кондор Паса!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I should go take a look!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, no-no-no, not like this! I have to
recover and get back to
training!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
With my mask on, I'm invincible! The
strongest, undefeated, bravest,
and most
perfect Umamusume!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It'll be okay. I'm strong. I'm tough! So it's
all good.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Okay, time to—ow-ow-ow!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Whoooaaaaa?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
T-T-T-T-T-T-Тренер?! Close! Your eyes!
Right now! Right this instant!
Now!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
She shouts at me so loudly that I
instinctively close my eyes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: There... we go!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Okay. You can open them now, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Whew... You didn't see anything, right?
After all, there was nothing to
see! Right?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: You. Saw. Nothing. Right?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Talk about scary...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Good, I'm glad to hear it! By the way, what
brings you here, Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Oh, could it be that you heard my voice
earlier? And now you're here
to check on
me?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: Are your legs all right? Let me see.

text_block_list.text:
Ah—no, really, they're fine! All bueno!
Gracias for the concern, but
I'm right as
rain!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
More importantly, you came flying in here
just because you heard my
cries of pain?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Such passion! You're overflowing with fiery
passion! I might even melt!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Seeing you get all fired up like this makes
me feel better already!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Looks like the world's strongest racer
really does need a trusty partner
in crime!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list:
So you're really aiming to be the world's
strongest?

text_block_list.text: Tch, tch, tch. Trainer, I'm not aiming... I'm proving that I'm the world's strongest!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
That's my promise to Papa's mask. He
handed it down to me, you
know.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
He told me, "This is your papa's mask—the
mask of the world's
strongest masked
wrestler! Once you put it on, you'll be the
world's
strongest too, El!"
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
When I put the mask on, the weak and
cowardly crybaby El vanished.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
In her place, Эль Кондор Паса—the world's
bravest, speediest, and
strongest
racer—was booorn!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I swore by this mask that one day, I would
make a name for myself as
the world's
strongest racer!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: O-ouch!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: D-don't worry, it's nothing!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Contrary to her words, she looks like she's
in pain. Those consecutive
training
programs must have done a number on her
body...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! Today... might not be the
best day, but I wanna try
your training
program next!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Heheh, I know what you're thinking. After all, you are the one who came to scout me straight away.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I bet you're starting to get reeeal
impatient waiting for your turn to
train me,
right?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'll grant you that wish of yours! Next time,
let's meet on the track!
Chao!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: O-o-ouuuch!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
...I still can't match her in energy, but for
now, it looks like I'm next up
in El Condor
Pasa's training queue.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now, what kind of training program does
someone aiming to be the
strongest in the
world need? I'll need to take my time and
give this
some thought...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
